reason: A deterministic contract regression testing harness for DeepSeek Harness plugins that exercises real tool pipelines in isolated subprocesses and validates schemas, events, failures, cancellation, and concurrency.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 插件的确定性契约回归测试工具，可在隔离子进程中运行真实管线并验证工具调用、事件流、错误处理、取消和并发行为。
summaries.en: A deterministic contract regression testing tool for DeepSeek Harness plugins that runs real pipelines in isolated subprocesses and validates tool calls, event streams, failures, cancellation, and concurrency.

capabilities: Runs plugin contract regression cases in isolated subprocesses
Registers scripted language-model adapters for deterministic test scenarios
Executes registered tools and asserts session event sequences
Checks schemas, rendering behavior, cancellation handling, missing parameters, concurrency, and process footprints
Produces command-line test reports and exit codes
